title: AttestArc eval-result artifact (digest-bound)
description: The small JSON the eval step emits and the promotion policy consumes. It is trusted ONLY when it is BOUND to the exact inputs it was produced over: the candidate entry being promoted (candidate_sha256), the immutable baseline it was judged against (baseline_manifest_sha256), and the trusted eval corpus (eval_corpus_sha256). knowledge_compile._load_eval_result_verified recomputes all three digests and refuses the result on any mismatch, so a bare {"passed": true} — or a passing result recycled from a different candidate/baseline/corpus — can never satisfy the auto-promote gate. passed:true additionally requires an empty failures list. This is NOT an eval-runner: the behavioral evals stay manually judged; what this artifact binds is that a given judgement belongs to a given change.

candidate_sha256.description: canonical digest of the candidate entry this result was produced over (knowledge_compile.canonical_entry_digest)

baseline_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the immutable baseline manifest.json the candidate was judged against

eval_corpus_sha256.description: digest of the trusted eval corpus (knowledge_compile.eval_corpus_digest over evals/cases/*.yaml)

passed.description: true only when every considered case passed; requires an empty failures list

failures.description: case ids that failed (empty when passed)
